_comment: Copy to config/salaries.json to override computed salaries with the league's authoritative sheet. 'season' is the season these salaries are current AS OF; the app escalates forward to the upcoming keeper season. Each entry is a bare salary number, or { salary, yearsKept }. Supplying yearsKept makes escalation exact even for players with pre-2022 history the API can't see. Keys can be Sleeper player ids (byPlayerId) or player names (byName).
